jobs.label: Brace spears
jobs.prompt: One compact SQUARE game icon on a transparent background, drawn as a Vietnamese Dong Ho folk woodblock print. Exactly three upright spears, spaced evenly across the square. Smooth ochre wooden shafts with hand-carved black outlines; each shaft roughly three times the length of its narrow pointed iron blade. Spearheads are slender steel lancets, ivory-grey pigment, tiny plain dark sockets: not broad leaves. The total silhouette is nearly square because the three spears are well spaced apart. Stout enough to read as a 30px UI icon, sparse woodblock grain, flat matte pigment, no decoration. All three spears are separate and completely visible, with clear transparent gaps and margin. No people, flag, tassels, bamboo nodes, scenery, labels, border, shadow, glow, paper or backdrop. Actual transparent PNG cutout.

jobs.label: Charge
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated raster game icon, a small Vietnamese Đông Hồ folk woodblock print. The design must be simple and readable at 30 pixels. Hand-carved warm soot-black outlines, matte earth-ochre wooden parts, small muted red accents only where requested, subdued ivory-grey metal, sparse natural print grain. Flat pigment blocks, mildly irregular ink contours, only essential carved lines. TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG: background pixels and spaces between objects must have alpha zero. Do not draw a checkerboard, white backdrop, paper, shadows, labels, border or scene. Center the complete motif with a generous transparent margin. No humans, soldiers, faces, helmets, tassels, flags, decorative patterns, bamboo nodes, gradients or 3D rendering. Subject: THREE slender long wooden Vietnamese infantry spears thrust toward the UPPER RIGHT in a compact staggered attack wedge. All three shafts parallel, tilted 45 degrees; middle spear projects furthest forward, other two are one step behind. Clearly three separate spears with open gaps and no crossing. Shaft is smooth ochre wood, about 75% of each weapon's length; tip plus small socket is the remaining 25%. Compact nearly square composition, shafts stout enough to read at 30px. Each iron blade is a very slim pointed triangular lancet, only twice the thin shaft width, light ivory-grey fill with black key-block outline. No leaf or paddle shapes. One short muted vermilion brush mark along each wooden shaft supplies a lively folk-print accent. No flag, pennant, modern arrow glyph, speed lines or other objects. The spear tips themselves show the direction of the charge.
